announcement.title: 0.4.18-b1 is now available!
announcement.message: Scarlet 0.4.18-b1 makes moderation actions post to Discord in seconds instead of minutes: burst polling kicks in for Scarlet-initiated actions and re-arms on any in-game moderation wave, while a 5-minute audit overlap window guarantees out-of-order entries are never lost. Avatar statuses now work without VRChat launch options through a tiered fallback (avatar databases, image verification that sees through same-named clones, and the VRChat API), with a readable compact stats dialog and a Show all details toggle. Avatar search gains a Manage Providers dialog, three new databases (avtr.zip, PAW, KitsuneDB), fixed NSVR/WorldBalancer endpoints, and tolerant response parsing. Exports get a live progress dialog with cancel, a clear-your-20GB-logs-first prompt, and a VRChat-running check with PID. Fixes include cache cleanup no longer fighting the live log, the remaining light-grey theme patches, and Windows display-scaling UI corruption.
